# SCI-FLT-MATCHED_TO_SCI-FRUIT v0.1/r0.1

Status: one-way producer-envelope boundary draft; no FRUIT contract, algorithm,
consumer query, implementation, or use is authorized

Producer: `SCI-FLT-MATCHED`

Future consumer authority: `SCI-FRUIT` successor contract tranche

FLT preserves a first-class interface sufficient for a future authorized
FRUIT method to consume the filtered amplitude product without reconstructing
undocumented FLT implementation state. At minimum it identifies filtered
quantity, template scientific object, actual and available response type,
valid support, output anchors/WCS, units/calibration, method and resolved/
realized state identity, uncertainty/covariance availability, lifecycle, and
provenance. Additional FLT state required by a future authorized FRUIT method
shall remain exactly available or reconstructable through lineage.

The exact response/state query vocabulary is declared by FLT only after an
authorized named use exists; FLT does not guess it. Unsupported queries are
unavailable. A fixed-state response is not strengthened into full-procedure
response by the consumer.

This envelope defines no FRUIT source model, subtraction/add-back, recurrence,
learning, stopping, restart, selection, response, uncertainty, convergence, or
interpretation. No SRC boundary is created. A genuine FRUIT method receives a
separate scientific contract tranche.
